ServiceItem.title: Haircut & Styling
description: Our Haircut & Styling service is designed to enhance your natural look with precision, creativity, and expert techniques. Whether you prefer a classic cut or a modern trend, our professional stylists tailor each look to match your personality, face shape, and lifestyle.

We use advanced cutting techniques and premium styling products to ensure you get a look that's sharp, stylish, and easy to maintain. From everyday grooming to complete makeovers, we're here to bring out the best version of you.

jobs.title: Senior Hair Stylist
jobs.description: We are looking for an experienced Senior Hair Stylist with strong technical skills and a passion for creating exceptional looks for our clients.
jobs.jobOverview: We are looking for an experienced Senior Hair Stylist with strong technical skills and a passion for creating exceptional looks for our clients. If you have a keen eye for style, a creative mindset, and a commitment to client satisfaction, we'd love to hear from you.
responsibilities: Consult with clients to understand their preferences and suggest suitable styles
Provide expert haircuts, styling, and treatments
Stay updated with the latest hair trends and techniques
Ensure high standards of hygiene and safety
Build and maintain strong client relationships
Support and mentor junior stylists
qualifications: Proven experience as a Hair Stylist (3+ years preferred)
Strong knowledge of hair cutting, coloring, and styling techniques
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Passion for beauty and customer service
Relevant certification or diploma in hair styling (preferred)

jobs.title: Salon Manager
jobs.description: Join our team as a Salon Manager to lead daily operations, support the team and ensure an outstanding client experience.
jobs.jobOverview: We are seeking a proactive Salon Manager to lead daily salon operations, motivate stylists, maintain exceptional guest service standards, and drive luxury salon excellence.
responsibilities: Oversee daily salon operations and front desk scheduling
Manage inventory, equipment maintenance, and supply orders
Lead team meetings and motivate salon staff to achieve targets
Resolve client inquiries with premium hospitality standards
Monitor revenue, appointments, and service quality benchmarks
qualifications: 3+ years of experience in salon or hospitality management
Strong team leadership and conflict resolution abilities
Financial acumen and familiarity with salon scheduling software
Outstanding interpersonal and customer service skills

perks.title: Leadership Growth
perks.description: Direct career path to regional management

jobs.title: Hair Color Specialist
jobs.description: We are seeking a skilled Hair Color Specialist with a creative eye and knowledge of the latest color techniques.
jobs.jobOverview: Join Haicraft as a Hair Color Specialist to deliver high-end coloring services, from balayage and highlights to rich global tones, ensuring healthy and vibrant results.
responsibilities: Perform consultations on color formulation and hair integrity
Execute advanced coloring techniques including balayage, ombre, and corrective color
Recommend specialized aftercare regimens to protect color vibrancy
Stay on top of seasonal trends and innovative coloring products
qualifications: 2+ years experience dedicated to professional hair coloring
Thorough understanding of color chemistry and hair health
Portfolio demonstrating mastery of balayage, highlights, and toning
Colorist certification from an accredited academy preferred

perks.title: Attractive Earnings
perks.description: Generous commission structure on color services

perks.title: Masterclasses
perks.description: Sponsored training with global master colorists

perks.title: Creative Freedom
perks.description: Work with top-tier international color lines

perks.title: Premium Tools
perks.description: Access to the finest color products and styling gear

jobs.title: Receptionist
jobs.description: We are looking for a friendly and organized Receptionist to provide excellent customer service and support our salon team.
jobs.jobOverview: As the first point of contact for our luxury salon guests, the Receptionist delivers warm greetings, manages bookings seamlessly, and ensures client delight.
responsibilities: Greet salon clients warmly and offer welcome beverages
Schedule and confirm appointments via phone, email, and booking portal
Process payments and handle cashier reconciliation
Coordinate with stylists to manage appointment flow smoothly
qualifications: 1-2 years front desk or customer relations experience
Impeccable communication and polite telephone etiquette
Comfortable using computers, POS systems, and booking software
Polished presentation aligning with luxury salon standards

perks.title: Competitive Salary
perks.description: Fixed salary with monthly service rewards

perks.title: Skill Building
perks.description: Training in luxury hospitality and salon administration

jobs.title: Salon Assistant
jobs.description: Join our team as a Salon Assistant and help maintain a clean, organized and welcoming environment for our clients.
jobs.jobOverview: An ideal opportunity for an enthusiastic grooming enthusiast looking to launch their career, assisting senior stylists and learning luxury salon standards.
responsibilities: Prepare styling stations and sanitize equipment between clients
Assist with client shampooing, conditioning, and scalp treatments
Ensure laundry, fresh towels, and beverage stations are well-stocked
Shadow master stylists and participate in ongoing training sessions
qualifications: 0-1 year experience or recent cosmetology/hair styling graduate
Eagerness to learn and positive work ethic
Punctual, attentive, and reliable team player
Passion for building a career in the hair styling industry

perks.title: Fair Compensation
perks.description: Competitive starting pay plus daily client tips

perks.title: Stylist Fast-Track
perks.description: Accelerated mentorship to junior stylist role
